name: AIDS Drug Assistance Program (ADAP)
description: California's AIDS Drug Assistance Program provides life-saving HIV/AIDS medications and health insurance assistance to low-income Californians living with HIV who lack adequate coverage.
fullDescription: California's AIDS Drug Assistance Program provides life-saving HIV/AIDS medications and health insurance assistance to low-income Californians living with HIV who lack adequate coverage.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free FDA-approved HIV/AIDS medications on the ADAP formulary
- Premium payment assistance for private health insurance (OA-HIPP)
- Premium payment assistance for Medicare Part C and Part D plans
- For California residents 18+ with income up to 600% FPL (MAGI)
- For people not fully covered by Medi-Cal or other insurance
howToGetIt: Make an appointment with a certified ADAP Enrollment Worker at an ADAP enrollment site (use the state's site locator or call the ADAP call center at 844-421-7050, Monday-Friday 8am-5pm). You'll need proof of HIV diagnosis, California residency, income, and current insurance status. Re-enroll in person every year before your birthday.
keywords: ADAP, AIDS, HIV, antiretroviral, medication, free, insurance assistance, OA-HIPP, Medicare, undocumented, HIV drugs
